class.name: EnvironmentQueryTickBudget
class.brief_description: Shared per-tick microsecond ledger for multiple incremental EQS queries.
class.description: Holds separate regular and urgent work pools across all AI controllers sharing the same instance. Call [method begin_tick] once per authoritative simulation tick, then call [method try_admit_step] immediately before a query's [method EnvironmentQuery3D.step_incremental_top_positions_timed], bound that call by [method get_remaining_us], and record the native measured time with [method record_step]. Admission is rejected when the appropriate pool is exhausted; any one candidate can still exceed the soft allowance. This only accounts for time supplied by the caller and does not postpone simulation, attack, movement, navigation or network work. The ledger is main-thread, transient, and does not autonomously run queries.

method.name: begin_tick
method.description: Initialize a new nonnegative server tick with independent regular and urgent quotas of 0–1000000 microseconds each. A repeated call for the same tick and matching quotas is idempotent and does not refill a spent budget. Returns false for invalid input, inconsistent same-tick quotas or an uncommitted step from the previous tick.

method.name: try_admit_step
method.description: Opens one synchronous native EQS work admission if the selected pool has positive remaining microseconds. Repeated admissions before recording or cancelling the pending step are rejected. The urgent and regular pools never borrow from one another.

method.name: record_step
method.description: Debit one previously admitted work step using its measured native scorer microseconds (0–1000000000). Zero-microsecond calls charge one unit to prevent infinitely many free steps. A single expensive candidate may overdraw its pool, but subsequent grants in that pool will be denied until the next tick.

method.name: cancel_pending_step
method.description: Discard an uncommitted admission (for example when a query fails to start). Safe to call repeatedly. Does not refund already recorded work.

method.name: get_remaining_us
method.description: Nonnegative remaining microsecond allowance in the selected pool. Returns zero before the first tick or after quota exhaustion.

method.name: get_tick
method.description: Active authoritative tick, or -1 before initialization.

method.name: get_regular_spent_us
method.description: Charged microseconds consumed by ordinary EQS steps this tick.

method.name: get_urgent_spent_us
method.description: Charged microseconds consumed by urgent EQS steps this tick.

method.name: get_regular_completed
method.description: Completed ordinary native EQS work steps this tick.

method.name: get_urgent_completed
method.description: Completed urgent native EQS work steps this tick.

method.name: get_denied_count
method.description: Rejected work admissions this tick, including overlapping admissions.

method.name: is_pending
method.description: True while an admission is awaiting recording or explicit cancellation.
